Definition: {properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of}
BiblicalUsage: 1) from, out of, by, by reason of, at, more than; 1a) from, out of (of place); 1b) from, by, as a result of, by reason of, at, according to, (of source); 1c) from (of time); 1d) beyond, more than (in comparisons)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
